title: Select
description: A single-choice dropdown with full keyboard support, groups and form integration.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A controlled select: pass value and onChange.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: SelectGroup, SelectLabel and SelectSeparator organize options; disabled options cannot be picked.

sizes-and-states.title: Sizes, states and FormControl
sizes-and-states.description: Three sizes, invalid and disabled states; inside a FormControl the trigger gets its label, description and required state.

SelectProps.onChange: Called with the value of the newly selected item
SelectProps.defaultOpen: Whether the popup is initially open
SelectProps.onOpenChange: Called when the popup opens or closes
SelectProps.placeholder: Text shown in the trigger while nothing is selected
SelectProps.invalid: Shows the error state (also set by an invalid FormControl)
SelectProps.disabled: Disables the select; inherited from a FormControl unless set
SelectProps.name: Name of the hidden native select, used in forms
SelectProps.id: id of the trigger (defaults to the FormControl's id)
SelectProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label of the trigger when there is no visible label
SelectProps.ariaDescribedBy: Extra ids of elements describing the trigger
SelectProps.className: Additional class name of the trigger
SelectProps.contentClassName: Additional class name of the popup

SelectItemProps.value: Value of the option (must not be empty)
SelectItemProps.textValue: Text used for typeahead when the content is not plain text
